concepts.title: वासुकी: जिसकी एक फुंकार से कांपते हैं देवता
concepts.hook: जिस सांप के डर से इंद्र का सिंहासन हिलता था, वो कैसे बना शिव का हार?
concepts.core_angle: The psychological twist: Vasuki is not just a serpent king but the ultimate symbol of surrender—the one who could destroy gods chose to become a necklace, revealing that true power lies in devotion, not domination.
concepts.recommended_topic_arg: Vasuki the serpent king: how the king of nagas became Shiva's ornament, exploring the paradox of power and surrender

concepts.title: समुद्र मंथन का वो सांप जिसने ब्रह्मांड को बचाया
concepts.hook: जब देवता और असुर मिलकर अमृत निकाल रहे थे, तब वासुकी ने अपना शरीर रस्सी बना दिया—लेकिन क्यों?
concepts.core_angle: The story tension: Vasuki sacrificed his body to churn the ocean, but the real twist is that his poison nearly destroyed the world—only Shiva's intervention saved it, showing that even divine cooperation can unleash catastrophe.
concepts.recommended_topic_arg: Samudra Manthan: Vasuki's role as the churning rope and the hidden danger of his poison that almost ended creation

concepts.title: वासुकी की मौत का रहस्य: क्या सच में सांप मरा था?
concepts.hook: क्या आप जानते हैं कि वासुकी को कई बार मरने का श्राप मिला, लेकिन वो फिर भी जिंदा है?
concepts.core_angle: The psychological twist: Vasuki's immortality is a curse, not a boon—he is doomed to shed his skin and live through ages, watching everything he loves perish, making him the most tragic figure in Hindu mythology.
concepts.recommended_topic_arg: The immortality curse of Vasuki: why the serpent king cannot die and the loneliness of eternal life

concepts.title: जब वासुकी ने शिव को अपना ज़हर दिया
concepts.hook: शिव ने हलाहल पिया, लेकिन उस ज़हर का असली स्रोत कौन था? जानिए वो कहानी जो आपने कभी नहीं सुनी।
concepts.core_angle: The story tension: The poison that Shiva drank came from Vasuki's mouth during the churning—but Vasuki didn't spit it out; he offered it willingly, testing whether the gods deserved his sacrifice.
concepts.recommended_topic_arg: Vasuki and the Halahala poison: the untold story of the serpent king's test of the gods during Samudra Manthan

concepts.title: वासुकी के 5 रहस्य जो आपको हिला देंगे
concepts.hook: वासुकी सिर्फ एक सांप नहीं, बल्कि एक ऐसा राजा है जिसके पास अपनी सेना, महल और रानी थी—जानिए उसकी दुनिया के 5 अनसुने रहस्य।
concepts.core_angle: The psychological twist: Vasuki ruled an underwater kingdom (Naglok) with advanced civilization, and his story mirrors human politics—betrayal, alliances, and war—making him a relatable yet terrifying monarch.
